Alerts
Sign up for announcements of important information (e.g., warnings of natural disasters) sent to you / your phone through email or text message.
Friendly Rider
Friendly Rider Transit operates throughout the county and in adjacent townships to the west of Wadena providing services to the general population, and the elderly and disabled.
Jail Custody List
Access the Wadena County Jail in custody list.
Medication Drop Box
A medication drop box is now located at the Wadena County Sheriff’s Office in the lobby area.
Warrant List
View the Wadena County Sheriff's Office active warrant listing.
Passport Acceptance Facility
Access contact information for the Passport Acceptance Facility.
Paying Property Taxes
Learn about paying taxes online.
Real Estate Recordings
There are 2 real estate recording systems in Minnesota: Abstract and Torrens. There are different requirements for recording the documents in each system.
Transfer Deeds
View transfer deed requirements.
Veterans Services
The Wadena County Veterans Services Officer performs such functions as acting as the veterans' primary advocate and resource and offers a wide variety of essential services for the county's veterans and dependents.
Vital Statistics
The County Recorder’s Office is a local Registrar of the Vital Records for the Minnesota Department of Heath. Records include births, deaths, and marriages for Wadena County.
